reference_corpus.scope: Unique exact binary64 normal-price open-cap inputs; saved independent roots, not a uniform proof.

direct_d.candidate: H-adaptive direct-D counts with non-increasing cell error bounds and cubic inverse
direct_d.scope: Common finish: cubic inverse on all accepted leaves; direct D for .001<t<=.5, and .5<t<=1 with h.hi>=2; all transported wing/small/core seed leaves. Conditional inherited seed/Mills/primitive contracts.
direct_d.method: Rigorous moment intervals, Bernstein D0 model enclosures, source-order rounding bounds for compensated D0, initial I3, odd recurrence, reciprocal factorials, and t-square Horner with exact t=s/2 so |RN(t^2)-t^2|<=u*t^2+nu. Recomputed leaf-wise complete rational-update bounds plus finite-HH transport and exact rational cubic-update difference.
direct_d.adaptive_selector_binding: Exact source selector; restoring the baseline selector matches the reviewed direct-D hash
primitive_contracts: RN-even binary64 basic ops, correctly rounded FMA and sqrt, gradual underflow, preserved source order without unsafe contraction/reassociation
exp relative error <=u=2^-53; inherited log/log1p preprocessing contracts
conditional_inherited_premises: The continuous seed cover, true-Mills model, residual ledger and final-three compensated reserve are imported certificates; this checker binds their reviewed hashes and audits all prerequisite endpoints, but does not regenerate those certificates.

The D0 high suffix and three compensated stages satisfy the inherited coefficient, argument, high/low and centering bounds. The first-moment rounding reserve covers low cross products and recovery errors; all subsequent recurrence steps are bounded explicitly.

compact_layout_equivalence.method: Exact reverse of reviewed load/type notation matches historical source hashes; all retained coefficient bits match the hash-bound archived table. Low components at indices 3..24 are never evaluated.

simd_backend.rounding: Independent binary64 lanes; mul_add_precise with a single rounding; no lane reduction. Primitive correctness is conditional.

large_fast.scope: Large fast Mills degree 16, unchanged degree-13 asymptotic and compensated final kernel; 34 continuous table cells and 114 continuous residual boxes
primitive_contracts: RN-even binary64 basic/FMA/sqrt, gradual underflow, source order, one-rounding lane-wise FMA
conditional_imports: Mills integral, moment recurrence, CF/Gaussian series and degree-24 Taylor remainder lemmas from the bound reference; their rational enclosures are recomputed
Unchanged target formation produces normalized DD with abs(target.hi)<=705 and a root inside the initial bracket
Unchanged precise high residual error <=2^-38, |F derivative|<=128 on bracket, and precise final-correction contract
large_fast.limits: Conditional continuous source-component proof, not a whole-domain solver certificate, end-to-end Lean proof, vendor-libm guarantee or speed claim.

as1.scope: atan helper only; full source AS1 rho composition is separate; no exact-minimax assertion.
